singleLineStoryFixture.english: Today, I decided to slow down.
I made time for a quiet morning.
Instead of checking my phone, I opened my notebook.
A warm cup of tea helped me settle in.
I wrote down one thing I wanted to remember.
It did not have to be anything special.
Small moments can make an ordinary day feel different.
Tomorrow, I want to make time for them again.

footnotes.phrase: It did not have to be anything special.
